positive_snippets: I had an issue with the amount of ambient noise which may have been otherwise unnoticeable to few people. I had a discussion with the management that I wanted to check out and was reassured that I would be getting a refund. Management is trustworthy and honest. Despite me not having completed my stay and checked out early they were cordial and overall experience was good. Thank you to the proprietor of the property who was understanding and considered my case.
Good stay. The service was good. Good staff. Overall a good affordable stay. Please check the location before booking if that's a must for you.
Very clean rooms and well-maintained premises. The staff was polite, helpful, and professional. Great experience overall.
negative_snippets:
Not recommended. Bad service.

During check-in, i was not even guided to my room. They told me my room number and gave me the key. That's it. The receptionist did not speak English, i was having a problem communicating with him.

Bedsheet was torn and not clean. Found hairs. Stayed for 2 nights and I can't sleep comfortably. The Towel given to me was not fully dry. It was torn as well. Also, There's no shop nearby.

I booked this hotel online after reading many positive reviews. However,  i am disappointed with the service.  I do not recommend this hotel. I am not getting for the price i pay.
